text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki takes 1st—!
(Waaaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ngh, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Members
text_block_list.text: Lady Fujiii! Great run!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was awesome! When I heard your 
aptitudes leaned toward miles, I wondered 
how things would turn out!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Still! Win or lose, you were magnificent! 
You took on that massive wall head-on!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
What's next? The Arima Kinen, maybe? I 
can't wait!

The entire grandstand erupted in praise of 
Fuji Kiseki's victory.

Fuji Kiseki is enveloped by passionate, 
thunderous applause.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you so much! Thanks to your 
support, I was able to give it my absolute 
all!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And so, this challenge draws to a close. I 
promise to show you an even greater 
miracle in the next race!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Until then, a brief farewell!

Fuji Kiseki bowed respectfully, then 
snapped her fingers—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
S-Smoke!? —Wait, huh!? Where's Fuji 
Kiseki!?

She made her exit in an exceptionally 
smart and stylish manner.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"About the next race to enter, how about 
the 'Takamatsunomiya Kinen'?"

Right after returning home from Kyoto, 
Fuji Kiseki visited the Trainer's office 
and said so.

I was certain you would aim for the Japan 
Cup or the Arima Kinen next.

The fact that they deliberately pushed for 
sprint races means, as expected—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No! It's true that long distances don't 
suit me, but that has nothing to do with 
this. It's for a different reason.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There are still some parts I haven't fully 
ironed out, so I'll consult with you on 
everything all at once later!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For now, I'd like to set our sights on the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen. Sorry for springing 
this on you out of nowhere. Is that okay?

Many mysteries remain, but... she surely 
has a plan in mind.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...There's something I've been thinking 
about. Basically, I want our Senior year 
shows to surpass everything we did in the 
Classic year!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Have you seen them yet? So many people 
have written articles covering our Triple 
Crown campaign, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Seeing her take on an unsuitable distance 
gave courage and inspiration to many 
cheering fans.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"High hopes for her future endeavors as 
well. Her race rotation has yet to be 
announced, but—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is full of anticipation for the 
'show' she will put on"—ehe, that tickles 
a bit!

True, practically every article was 
lavishing praise on her performance to an 
almost overwhelming degree.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It reached a grand, happy conclusion. It 
was an even bigger success than imagined!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is why everyone is searching for an 
even greater miracle. And I want to answer 
that call.

The chorus of praise did not cease for 
quite some time after that.

Far from it; aided by Fuji Kiseki's 
charming demeanor, flamboyant exits, and 
theatrical speeches, her popularity 
skyrocketed—

Countless articles and endless clip videos 
began to flood the internet day after day.
